Sandbox_EnshroudedSleepClockSpike_Enable: Runs one automatic clock-only acceleration test after the first in-world player appears.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleepClockSpike_Accele: Temporary world-clock acceleration for the diagnostic test. Default: 20x.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleepClockSpike_Warmup: Real-time delay after the first in-world player appears before acceleration begins.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleepClockSpike_TestSe: How long the accelerated clock test remains active before restoring the baseline.
